dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Dodecahedron is on the at-risk list due to behavior concerns. In the care center, Dodecahedron has shown signs of kennel stress, including excessive salivation that has left his neck and chest wet. Dodecahedron has warmed up to staff and loves playing with other dogs, but is struggling to acclimate in the care center despite best efforts to keep him comfortable. Medically, Dodecahedron has otitis externa.
